sourceNote: Ideas combining Walrus decentralized storage with Seal programmable encryption. These two primitives together enable a new category of privacy-preserving applications on Sui.

ideas.title: Confidential HR document storage with role-based decryption
ideas.summary: Offer letters, performance reviews, and compensation stored on Walrus. Seal policies gate access by HR role, manager, or employee. Audit trail on Sui.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal encryption policies map directly to org chart roles. Walrus stores documents cheaply. Sui objects audit access.
ideas.marketSignal: HR document breaches cost companies $4M+ average. Encrypted role-based access is a known enterprise need.

ideas.title: Dead man's switch for encrypted digital assets
ideas.summary: User stores encrypted keys, wills, or messages on Walrus. Seal time-lock decrypts if the user fails to check in within N days. Beneficiaries access automatically.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal time-locked encryption handles the reveal trigger. Walrus stores encrypted payloads. Sui clock module enforces timing.
ideas.marketSignal: Digital inheritance is an unsolved problem. $100B+ in crypto is estimated to be in lost or inaccessible wallets.

ideas.title: Encrypted cloud backup with user-controlled keys
ideas.summary: Files encrypted client-side, stored on Walrus. Only the user's Sui wallet can decrypt via Seal. No vendor can access data. Cross-device sync via Sui objects.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal owner-private encryption ensures only the user decrypts. Walrus provides permanent, redundant storage.
ideas.marketSignal: Cloud backup market is $15B+. Users increasingly demand zero-knowledge backup (Tresorit, SpiderOak).

ideas.title: Encrypted medical records with doctor-gated access
ideas.summary: Patient records stored on Walrus, encrypted with Seal. Doctors receive time-limited decryption capability. Patients revoke access at will. Full audit log on Sui.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal subscription/time-limited policies match healthcare access patterns. Walrus stores records permanently. Sui audits every access event.
ideas.marketSignal: Healthcare data breaches cost $10M+ average. Patient-controlled records are a known regulatory push.

ideas.title: Gated research publications with pay-per-access
ideas.summary: Academic papers stored on Walrus. Seal gates access by payment or institutional membership. Authors earn directly without publisher intermediaries.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal subscription policies handle institutional access. Walrus stores papers permanently. Sui PTBs handle payments to authors.
ideas.marketSignal: Academic publishing is a $30B industry with growing open-access pressure. Sci-Hub usage proves demand for access.

ideas.title: End-to-end encrypted group chat stored on Walrus
ideas.summary: Messages encrypted with Seal group policies, stored on Walrus. Only group members decrypt. Member addition and removal update Seal policy on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal allowlist policies gate group membership. Walrus stores message blobs. Sui objects track group state.
ideas.marketSignal: Signal has 40M+ users. Enterprise chat (Slack) is $30B+. Verifiable E2E group chat has no on-chain equivalent.

ideas.title: Time-locked music drops with encrypted pre-release
ideas.summary: Artists upload encrypted tracks to Walrus. Seal time-lock decrypts at release time. Pre-sale buyers get early access via NFT-gated Seal policies.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal time-locked encryption handles release scheduling. NFT-gated policies give early access to holders. Walrus stores audio permanently.
ideas.marketSignal: Music pre-release and exclusives drive streaming engagement. Artists seek direct-to-fan distribution.

ideas.title: NFT collection with encrypted art reveal mechanics
ideas.summary: Art stored encrypted on Walrus. Seal time-lock or event-triggered reveal decrypts art. No centralized server needed for reveal. Provably fair metadata.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal time-locked encryption replaces centralized reveal servers. Walrus stores art permanently. No IPFS gateway dependency.
ideas.marketSignal: NFT reveals are a standard mechanic. Centralized reveal servers are a recurring point of failure and trust.

ideas.title: Notarized digital evidence vault for legal proceedings
ideas.summary: Photos, videos, and documents timestamped and stored on Walrus. Seal encrypts until court order triggers decryption. Chain of custody on Sui.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus timestamps and stores evidence immutably. Seal policies gate access to authorized parties. Sui objects track chain of custody.
ideas.marketSignal: Digital evidence management is a growing legal tech market. Tamper-proof evidence is a court requirement.

ideas.title: Decentralized password manager with Seal encryption
ideas.summary: Passwords encrypted with Seal owner-private policy, stored on Walrus. Only the user's wallet decrypts. Cross-device sync without trusting a server.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal owner-private encryption ensures zero-knowledge storage. Walrus provides redundant permanent storage. No vendor lock-in.
ideas.marketSignal: LastPass breach (2022) exposed 30M users. Zero-knowledge password managers (1Password) are premium products.

ideas.title: Private NFT gallery with selective sharing
ideas.summary: Collectors store high-value NFT images encrypted on Walrus. Seal policies allow selective sharing with verified buyers or curators without exposing to public.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal allowlist policies gate viewing access. Walrus stores high-res art. Kiosk handles the commerce layer.
ideas.marketSignal: High-value NFT collectors want private galleries. Art dealers operate on invite-only viewing traditionally.

ideas.title: Private governance voting with encrypted ballots
ideas.summary: Voters encrypt ballot choices with Seal. Ballots stored on Walrus. After voting period, time-lock decrypts all ballots simultaneously for fair counting.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal time-locked encryption reveals all votes simultaneously after deadline. Eliminates bandwagon voting. Walrus stores ballots.
ideas.marketSignal: Snapshot processes 40K+ DAOs. All current DAO voting is plaintext, enabling strategic voting manipulation.

ideas.title: Verifiable random gift exchange with encrypted assignments
ideas.summary: Participants register on-chain. Assignments encrypted with Seal per-participant. Each person sees only their assignment. Organizer cannot peek.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal per-user encryption ensures only the recipient sees their assignment. Walrus stores all assignments. Verifiable randomness via Sui.
ideas.marketSignal: Secret Santa apps have millions of seasonal users. Verifiable fairness is a novel differentiator.

ideas.title: Subscription content platform with rotating access keys
ideas.summary: Creators publish encrypted content on Walrus. Seal subscription policies auto-expire. Subscribers renew on-chain. No piracy of download links.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal subscription policies handle auto-expiry natively. Walrus stores content. Sui objects track subscription state.
ideas.marketSignal: Patreon and OnlyFans combined revenue exceeds $5B. Content piracy remains their top challenge.

ideas.title: Corporate whistleblower vault with anonymous submission
ideas.summary: Employees submit encrypted reports to Walrus. Seal policies gate decryption to compliance officers only. ZK proofs verify employment without identity.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal encrypts per-compliance-officer. Walrus stores reports permanently. ZK proofs verify eligibility without doxxing.
ideas.marketSignal: SOX compliance requires whistleblower channels. Existing tools (EthicsPoint) are vendor-controlled, not verifiable.
